subject.title: fix(scripts): bound release CI summary GitHub lookups

question: Should full release validation fail a GitHub lookup after 60 seconds with no retry or longer release-specific allowance?
rationale: The implementation deliberately converts a potentially long workflow stall into a hard release-validation failure, and source tests cannot establish whether that operational SLA is appropriate for release runs.

options.title: Keep the 60-second bound
options.body: Accept the bounded fail-closed behavior after reviewing redacted live evidence that both a timeout and healthy GitHub request behave as intended.

options.title: Use a different release policy
options.body: Choose a longer bound or an explicit retry policy if normal GitHub latency can exceed one minute during release validation.

recommendation.title: Keep the 60-second bound
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded fail-closed behavior after reviewing redacted live evidence that both a timeout and healthy GitHub request behave as intended.
